name: mochart-monorepo
description: Monorepo for the mochart charting library, the movalid validation library, and the mochart demo app

scripts.preview:pages: PAGES_BASE=/ node scripts/build-pages.mjs && PAGES_BASE=/ node scripts/preview-pages.mjs
scripts.build:libs: npm run build -w @mochart/movalid && npm run build -w @mochart/core && npm run build -w @mochart/export && npm run build -w @mochart/react && npm run build -w @mochart/svelte && npm run build -w @mochart/vue && npm run build -w @mochart/lit && npm run build -w @mochart/angular
